extracted.intended_audience: users of the Illinois Administrative Code (lawyers, regulators, agency staff, and members of the public seeking state administrative rules)
extracted.subtask_description: A state government web index page listing the titles of the Illinois Administrative Code and providing a brief site-use disclaimer and search instruction. It helps users locate parts of the Code and warns about official/authenticity limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclaimer: unofficial database / citation warning
rubrics_metrics.description: This site provides access to the Illinois Administrative Code database that is maintained and updated weekly by the Illinois General Assembly. This database is NOT the "official" text of the Illinois Administrative Code. The accuracy of any specific provision originating from this site cannot be guaranteed. For an "official" copy of any administrative rule, contact the Secretary of State's Index Department for a certified copy of the document filed with the Secretary of State. This site should not be cited as an official or authoritative source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains provenance and limits of the site's authority: the database is maintained and updated weekly but is not the certified official text; users seeking authoritative or citable copies must obtain certified copies from the Secretary of State's Index Department. Treat content here as a convenience/reference, not as legally binding or definitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search usage instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: To search the Administrative Code listed below, simply type the keyword(s) you are searching for and click the Submit button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basic site use guidance for locating rules within the listed titles; implies keyword-based search is the intended navigation method for this index page.
